user.title: Configure Effy
user.description: Set up effective PV loss distribution. Assign your PV inputs and the four BMS counters: grid import and discharge (inputs), charge and grid export (outputs). At least one input and one output (charge or grid export) are required. Optional, for the battery efficiency: the state of charge sensor together with the battery capacity entity, and the valley hysteresis. Optional, for the EPS/UPS port of the inverter: one signed power sensor (positive when energy leaves through the port, negative when it enters). While the port is in use, the standby and efficiency sensors wait for a quiet or pure slot. Optional, for any other sensor you want Effy's counter and gap logic for (for example the house's grid import): the additional sensors. Each gets a derived power (energy counter) or smoothed (power sensor) series and takes part in no loss calculation; press the history button to fill the history of a new one.

data.grid_import_sensor: Grid import counter (BMS input: energy from the grid)
data.discharge_sensor: Discharge counter (BMS input: energy out of the battery, battery side)
data.charge_sensor: Charge counter (BMS output: energy into the battery, battery side)
data.grid_export_sensor: Grid export counter (BMS output: energy to the grid)
data.eps_sensor: EPS/UPS sensor (optional: one signed power sensor of the EPS/UPS port; positive = energy leaves through the port, negative = another inverter feeds it)
data.additional_sensors: Additional sensors (optional: any energy or power sensor in W, kW, Wh or kWh; Effy writes a derived power or smoothed series for each, no effective value, and uses them in no calculation)
data.soc_sensor: State of charge sensor (optional, for the battery efficiency; set together with the capacity)
data.capacity_entity: Battery capacity entity (optional, in Wh or kWh: a sensor, number or input_number; set together with the state of charge)
data.valley_hysteresis: Valley hysteresis (state of charge points, at least 15)
data.debug_export: Write a debug export with every history recalculation (a file in effy_debug, for a bug report)

error.at_least_one_input: Please select at least one input sensor (PV, grid import or discharge).
error.sensor_in_two_roles: A sensor can only have one role. Please remove it from one of the roles.
error.at_least_one_output: Please assign at least one output counter (charge or grid export).
error.output_needs_device_class: Every output sensor must have a device class (power or energy) set. Please pick a different sensor or fix its device class first.
error.soc_and_capacity_together: The state of charge sensor and the battery capacity entity belong together: set both or neither.
error.soc_needs_measurement: The state of charge sensor must have the state class 'measurement'. Please pick a different sensor.
error.capacity_unit_not_energy: The battery capacity must be in Wh or kWh. Please pick a different entity or fix its unit.
error.eps_needs_power_class: The EPS/UPS sensor must be a power sensor (device class 'power'). Please pick a different sensor or fix its device class.
error.eps_needs_measurement: The EPS/UPS sensor must have the state class 'measurement'. Please pick a different sensor.
error.eps_unit_not_power: The EPS/UPS sensor must report W or kW. Please pick a different sensor or fix its unit.
error.additional_unit_not_supported: An additional sensor must report W, kW, Wh or kWh. Please remove it or fix its unit.
